home.subtitle: Pick a server and connect in one tap.
home.networkClean: No known blocks on your network

server.howBody: Tap Connect — your VPN app opens automatically and imports the config. If nothing happens, install the app first using the link below.
server.soonBody: We'll notify you when it ships.

profile.title: Profile
profile.aggregatedHint: One link, all of your servers. Paste it into any compatible VPN app.
profile.rotateConfirm: Rotate the universal link? Old imports on devices will stop syncing.
profile.contributeBodyOn: On — your probe results help flag new blocks for others. Turn off any time.
profile.contributeBodyOff: Off — you won't share probe results.
profile.contributeHint: Only URL, country, ASN and pass/fail are sent. No personal data, ever.
profile.contributeBannerTitle: Data collection is on by default
profile.contributeBannerBody: Starting today, probe results on your network are shared anonymously so other users learn about new blocks faster. You can turn this off any time.
profile.myDataEmpty: You haven't contributed any signals yet. They'll show up here once the censorship check runs.
profile.myDataDeleteConfirmBody: Your signals are tombstoned for 30 days then permanently erased. This cannot be undone.

tools.title: Tools
tools.ipProtectedBody: Your traffic is routed through the VPN.
tools.ipUnprotectedBody: Open a server and tap Connect.
tools.speedNote: Measured from the VPN server, not your device.
tools.censorshipIntro: We try to reach these sites directly from your device.
tools.freedomEntry: What's blocked on your network, right now
tools.freedomIntro: Based on OONI reports from {country} · {asn} in the last week.
tools.freedomUnknownSub: No recent OONI data for your network
tools.freedomSearchPlaceholder: Type a URL or domain — e.g. reddit.com
tools.freedomSearchEmpty: No matches yet — try typing a domain
tools.freedomTopBlocked: Most likely blocked on your network
tools.freedomNoData: No OONI data on your network yet. Try searching a specific site.
tools.freedomDetailVerdictUnknown: Not enough OONI data for {host} yet
tools.freedomDetailReasonConfirmedBlock: OONI has confirmed censorship of this URL on your network.
tools.freedomDetailReasonHighAnomaly: Most measurements from your network fail in a way consistent with a block (timeouts, TLS errors, blockpages).
tools.freedomDetailReasonPartialAnomaly: Some measurements show interference — intermittent or partial blocking.
tools.freedomDetailReasonNoData: Nobody has probed this URL from your network recently.
tools.freedomDetailReasonCommunityOnly: Community signals suggest something — but OONI data is thin.
tools.freedomDetailNoAsnBreakdown: No other networks with measurements in this window.
tools.freedomDetailWhyBody: We mark a URL Blocked when OONI has confirmed censorship, or when more than half of recent web_connectivity tests from your network failed. Degraded means a partial pattern. Reachable means most tests passed. Counts update hourly; results you see are cached for 15 minutes.
tools.freedomDetailDegradedConfidence: Showing country-wide data — ASN-scoped signal was thin.
tools.freedomDetailVerdictBlockedPlain: {host} looks blocked on your network right now
tools.freedomDetailVerdictDegradedPlain: {host} is working sometimes on your network
tools.freedomDetailVerdictUnknownPlain: Not enough recent checks to tell whether {host} works
tools.freedomDetailWhatHappened: Most recent checks from your network can't load this site.
tools.freedomDetailWhatHappenedReachable: Most recent checks from your network load this site fine.
tools.freedomDetailWhatHappenedDegraded: Some checks fail and some succeed — the site loads for some people, not others.
tools.freedomDetailSummaryParagraph: Over the last {days} days, {blocked} of {total} checks failed on your network.
tools.freedomDetailSummaryNoData: We don't have recent reports for this site on your network yet.
tools.freedomDetailHowMeasuredBody: A global network of volunteers runs automated tests that try to load this page from their phones and computers. When many tests fail in the same way on the same network, we flag it as blocked. Data is from the OONI project — ooni.org.
